description: React component for a Kanban board summary view with draggable columns, fullscreen toggle, and column collapsing features.

methods.name: toggleCollapsed
methods.description: Toggles the collapsed state of a column by its ID.

methods.name: moveColumn
methods.description: Reorders columns based on drag-and-drop interaction.

methods.name: computeScale
methods.description: Calculates scale factor for fullscreen grid based on column count.

methods.name: getStatusDotColor
methods.description: Returns color for card status dots.

methods.name: getStatusClass
methods.description: Returns CSS class for card status background color.
